AssumedApproved.description:
The service is assumed approved, with the question that would confirm it. Labelled, never
refused (D57): it partitions exactly like an evidenced service.
AssumedApproved.title: AssumedApproved

AvailabilityRef.description: A reference to an IC-11 availability surface by content hash.
AvailabilityRef.title: AvailabilityRef

BessDispatch.description: One direction at ``kw``: the merchant share plus each service's delivery, exactly.
BessDispatch.title: BessDispatch

CellTerms.description:
Everything in force in one cell: the site import and export limits at the connection point,
the partition of each battery direction, the energy stack and the thermal terms.
CellTerms.title: CellTerms

CloudHeartbeat.description: The cloud is alive (renews the edge's lease) and says whether the market link is up.
CloudHeartbeat.title: CloudHeartbeat

CommittedService.description:
A service the asset is committed to. Its battery slices and thermal commitments are in the
cells; this states what it is and what it rests on.

``sustain_min`` is how long a battery slice must be held: every positive slice has held energy
of at least ``ceil(kw x sustain_min / 60)`` kWh. A service delivered only by cooling turn-down
has no battery slice, and its ``sustain_min`` is not applicable (each thermal commitment
states its own duration).
CommittedService.title: CommittedService

ConnectionAgreementRef.description: The IC-1 agreement the restrictions apply under, by content hash.
ConnectionAgreementRef.title: ConnectionAgreementRef

ConstraintLibraryPin.description:
The constraint library the envelope was sized with (WP-SIZE-02). Dispatch compares its own
library with this (`check_constraint_library`).
ConstraintLibraryPin.title: ConstraintLibraryPin

DayGroup.description: A set of ISO weekdays (1 = Monday ... 7 = Sunday). The day groups partition the week.
DayGroup.title: DayGroup

DispatchEnvelope.description:
IC-3 v1.0.0: the terms live dispatch must honour at one site over one validity.

The template (``seasons`` x ``day_groups`` x ``bands`` → ``cells`` → ``terms``) and the dated
``overrides`` say which `CellTerms` are in force at every half-hour of ``[valid_from,
valid_until)``; ``resolved_hash`` is the hash of that compilation. Power kW, energy kWh, time
in minutes, temperatures in tenths of a degree: integers throughout, and every partition sums
exactly.
DispatchEnvelope.title: DispatchEnvelope

EnergyStack.description:
The usable energy, stacked bottom to top: ``resilience_floor_kwh``, energy held so
discharge services can be delivered (``held_up``), the merchant band, headroom held so charge
services can be absorbed (``held_down``), and withheld energy. The sum equals the usable
energy exactly. State of energy floor = resilience + held up; ceiling = usable - held down -
withheld (`flat_limits`).
EnergyStack.title: EnergyStack

EnvelopeInstall.description:
An IC-3 envelope and its compiled timeline, delivered to the edge to hold. The timeline
must be the envelope's compilation (by hash), so the edge needs no clock logic.
EnvelopeInstall.title: EnvelopeInstall

EnvelopeRef.description:
A reference to an IC-3 envelope by content hash, with its source input hash (what IC-8,
IC-15 and the ledger embed).
EnvelopeRef.title: EnvelopeRef

EnvelopeSource.description:
Where the envelope came from. ``input_hash`` is required and is never the hash of nothing;
the assessment quote's input hash equals it; ``run.run_id`` re-derives from the pins.
EnvelopeSource.title: EnvelopeSource

EvidenceRef.description: A reference to an IC-4 instance by its content hash (what IC-1 and others embed).
EvidenceRef.title: EvidenceRef

Evidenced.description: The service rests on an IC-4 evidence object (a contract, an award, an agreement).
Evidenced.title: Evidenced

ExpectedOutcome.description:
What the cloud expects at the end of the period (for the envelope check and telemetry
reconciliation); the edge does not actuate these.
ExpectedOutcome.title: ExpectedOutcome

FailSafe.description:
What the edge reverts to on loss of the cloud or market link (spec B1-02): import at or
below the firm limit, state of energy at or above the resilience floor, markets declared
unavailable. ``resilience_floor_kwh`` equals the lowest resilience floor in force anywhere in
the validity, so entering fail-safe from any compliant state is already compliant.
FailSafe.title: FailSafe

ImportBasis.description:
What a cell's import limit rests on. Only a ``firm`` limit is bounded by the fail-safe
firm limit; a non-firm or DNO-scheduled limit may exceed it while it is granted.
ImportBasis.title: ImportBasis

IssuerRole.description:
Who issued the document. **Neura is not an issuer role**: a claim Neura authors about
itself or a site is an assumption or a derived record, never evidence. Neura may *verify*.
IssuerRole.title: IssuerRole

MeasurementPoint.description: Where a temperature limit is measured. ASHRAE classes are defined at the IT inlet.
MeasurementPoint.title: MeasurementPoint

NotApplicable.description:
A term that does not exist for this record (e.g. a LIFO position on a firm connection).

Distinct from `Unknown`: "not applicable" is a statement about the agreement, "unknown" is a
statement about our knowledge of it. Both carry a reason.
NotApplicable.title: NotApplicable

OperatorCommand.description:
A Neura ops command to the edge, audited under IC-13 (the command id and the hash of the
audit event that allowed it).
OperatorCommand.title: OperatorCommand

Override.description:
Replaces the template's terms wholesale over ``[start, end)`` (UTC, on the grid): a
maintenance outage, a stress event, a dated call. Never a field-by-field merge.
Override.title: Override

PeerHead.description: The last frame the sender received from the other side: an implicit acknowledgement.
PeerHead.title: PeerHead

PowerPartition.description:
One direction's rating, partitioned: ``resilience_kw + sum(services) + merchant_kw +
withheld.kw`` equals the rating exactly (checked by the envelope, which holds the rating).
A zero service slice is absence: a slice is at least 1 kW.
PowerPartition.title: PowerPartition

QuoteBinding.description:
The IC-12 quote the envelope was exported from, by id and input hash. A `QuoteRecord` is
mutable through its lifecycle, so it is not bound by content hash.
QuoteBinding.title: QuoteBinding

RecordClass.description:
What the envelope is. ``synthetic_fixture`` exactly when the site id starts ``SYNTHETIC-``;
consumers must refuse it outside tests. ``live`` may hold no unknown reference.
RecordClass.title: RecordClass

ResolvedTimeline.description:
IC-3 v1.0.0: an envelope compiled onto UTC half-hours (`resolve`). Step-encoded: a step
starts wherever the terms change. Terms are keyed by their own content hash, so the timeline
does not depend on how the template named them. Read it with no clock logic
(`timeline_terms_at`); trust it by ``content_hash() == envelope.resolved_hash``.
ResolvedTimeline.title: ResolvedTimeline

RunPins.description:
The assessment run's four pins, restated so ``run_id`` can be re-derived (`derive_run_id`,
the `gridq.provenance` derivation).
RunPins.title: RunPins

ScenarioSetRef.description: A reference to an IC-2 set by content hash (what IC-3 envelopes and run records embed).
ScenarioSetRef.title: ScenarioSetRef

Season.description: A set of calendar months. The envelope's seasons partition the twelve months.
Season.title: Season

SetpointPeriod.description: One period of setpoints, inside one half-hour of the grid, on whole minutes.
SetpointPeriod.title: SetpointPeriod

SetpointSchedule.description:
A schedule for one site, executed inside one IC-3 envelope (checked against its compiled
timeline, trusted by ``resolved_hash``). It names what it supersedes by content hash.
SetpointSchedule.title: SetpointSchedule

StudyBasisLabel.description:
The run was priced on a named study basis (D46/D55). ``label`` is that basis's banner and
must be shown wherever the envelope is (`basis_banner`).
StudyBasisLabel.title: StudyBasisLabel

TemperatureRange.description: The lowest and highest temperature a schedule expects over a period, at a point.
TemperatureRange.title: TemperatureRange

ThermalCommitment.description:
A committed cooling turn-down: ``reduction_kw`` held for ``duration_min`` from any start in
the cell, for a declared service.
ThermalCommitment.title: ThermalCommitment

ThermalEnvelope.description:
The site's IC-11 surface by hash, and its binding IT-safety band restated (equal to the
surface's ``limits.binding``: the hard limit). Each cell's band lies inside it.
ThermalEnvelope.title: ThermalEnvelope

ThermalTerms.description:
A cell's operating band (inside the envelope's binding band, at its point) and its thermal
commitments. No commitment is an empty tuple, never a zero.
ThermalTerms.title: ThermalTerms

TimeBand.description:
A half-open local-clock window ``[start_minute, end_minute)`` on `CLOCK`, on the 30-minute
grid. ``end_minute == 1440`` is midnight at the end of the day; a band never wraps midnight.
TimeBand.title: TimeBand

TimelineStep.description: From half-hour ``index`` (0 is ``valid_from``) to the next step, ``terms_hash`` holds.
TimelineStep.title: TimelineStep

TriggerCode.description: Why the edge is in fail-safe. Enum order breaks ties of rank (`primary_trigger`).
TriggerCode.title: TriggerCode

UnderwritingBasisLabel.description:
The run was priced on an underwriting basis. Accepted in shape; no underwriting basis is
implemented yet, so no fixture uses it. A basis id that names a study is refused here (D46).
UnderwritingBasisLabel.title: UnderwritingBasisLabel

UnderwrittenValue.description:
The value the assessment underwrote for a service, in whole pence a year, with its basis.
Read by IC-15; never an input to any invariant here.
UnderwrittenValue.title: UnderwrittenValue

Unknown.description:
A value that exists but is not known. Always explicit, always with a reason; never ``None``.

Serialised as ``{"kind": "unknown", "reason": "..."}``. ``kind`` is required (no default) so
a hand-written payload that omits it is refused rather than guessed at.
Unknown.title: Unknown

Withheld.description: Power not offered to anyone in this cell (a derating or an outage), with its reason.
Withheld.title: Withheld

WithheldReason.description: Why part of the asset is not offered at all in a cell (whole-asset availability).
WithheldReason.title: WithheldReason

description: IC-5 v1.0.0: one frame from the cloud to a site's edge.
title: CloudToEdgeFrame
